summary: John Wiley & Sons, Inc. disclosed via Form 8-K that its indirect wholly-owned subsidiary, John Wiley & Sons Ltd., entered into an Equity Purchase Agreement on June 1, 2026, to acquire all outstanding equity of CIG Emerald Midco LLC (doing business as Emerald Publishing) from CIG Emerald Midco LLC and Emerald Holding. The purchase price is GBP 337.5 million (~$452 million) in cash, funded from cash on hand. The acquisition of over 480 peer-reviewed journals and 8,000 books expands Wiley's research publishing portfolio. The filing includes customary representations, warranties, and indemnification provisions. No advisor or board recommendation is stated. Watch for closing conditions and regulatory approvals.
